digest.component_or_area: Repository history maintenance and Git plumbing operational script
propositions: Build a committed operational script using stock Git plumbing (fast-export/fast-import) to strip historical bridge state directories and reduce repository size from ~1 GiB to ~98 MB without introducing new dependencies.

Prove the rewrite on a fresh unfiltered scratch clone: commit and merge counts must match the original, the rewritten tree must be byte-identical to the old tree after dynamic re-add, and no commit may touch the target prefixes except the final HEAD.

The script must dynamically derive the re-add file set from the old-tip tree rather than hardcoding, parse fast-export data blocks by byte length to handle commit messages starting with M or D, and refuse to run on partial clones with a clear error message.

Validate that the rewritten branch pack size does not exceed 150 MB, the source remote branch and protected tag remain unchanged after the dry run, and all assertions complete before emitting success.
A representative review-bot event pushed after rewrite must increase pack size by less than 1 MB and make the old tip no longer an ancestor of the new tip.
The script must never perform a remote push operation during the dry run; publication ownership and remote tag deletion belong to a separate task with lease-based force-push protection.
